    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro ϑ hϑ
  cases ϑ with
  | zero => exact (Nat.lt_irrefl 0 hϑ).elim

    clear hϑ
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.zero_add]

      simpa only [jointProximityNat₂, ← hu] using h
    | succ n ih =>
      intro u hp
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ (n + 1)) Nat.one_le_two_pow
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) u e ?_) ?_
      · rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun (F := F)
          (multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close MC u e)]
        simpa only [multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close,
          ← Fin.init_def, ← multilinearCombine_recursive_form u,
          ENNReal.coe_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp
      · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
        intro r hr
        exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (MC := MC) ih u ⟨r, hr⟩
